up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity data for compounds tested against human dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (CHEMBL284). Filter for assays where the target is CHEMBL284 and the organism is Homo sapiens. Only include records that have a valid PubMed ID or DOI. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id if available, else DOI), assay_description, and target details (target_chembl_id, target_pref_name, organism). Ensure the activity relation is '=' for exact values.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description AS assay_description, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ON a.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL)
